title: Operationalization Matters: IC-Based Influence Approximation on Twitch Gamers
description: Lightweight reproducibility code and small verification artifacts for the accepted MAPR 2026 paper on IC-based influence approximation. The repository does not redistribute the Twitch Gamers dataset or precomputed processed experiment artifacts; those artifacts can be regenerated from the public dataset using the included pipeline.
